title: I Can't Say No to the Lonely Girl
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Model student Ayaka Sakurai is promised a university recommendation if she can coax truant classmate Sora Honda back to school. Sora overhears the deal and blackmails Ayaka into granting her daily requests, starting with a kiss. As Ayaka learns that Sora lives alone and has long had a crush on her, the arrangement turns into a romance supported by their friends, ending with the two living together after graduation.
life_message: Real connection begins when you drop self-interest and are honest about what someone means to you.
